subject: general
question: Which project is built for hydel power production and irrigation in the Sutlej river basin?
solution:
The correct answer is__** the Bhakra Nangal project.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhakra Nangal project **is a multipurpose project built on the Sutlej River in the northern Indian states of Punjab and Himachal Pradesh.
 
• The project was built for hydel power production and irrigation purposes.
 
• The project is one of the largest and most successful hydroelectric power projects in India.
 
• The project has a total installed capacity of 1,325 MW and can irrigate over 10 million acres of land in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Sutlej River**

 
 
• The Sutlej River is the longest of the five rivers that flow through the historic crossroads region of Punjab in northern India and Pakistan.
 
• The Sutlej River is also known as** Satadree.**
 
• It is the easternmost tributary of the **Indus River**.
 
• The Bhakra Dam is built around the river Sutlej to provide irrigation and other facilities to the **states of Punjab, Rajasthan, and Haryana.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Nagarjuna project** is a multipurpose project built on the **Krishna River in Andhra Pradesh, India.** It was built for the purpose of irrigation and hydel power production.
 
• **Hirakud project** is a multipurpose project built on the **Mahanadi River in Odisha, India**. It was built for the purpose of irrigation, flood control, and hydel power production.
 
• **The Sardar Sarovar Dam** is a multipurpose project built on the** Narmada River in Gujarat, India**. It was built for the purpose of irrigation, drinking water supply, and hydel power production.
